physical_orientation_audit_method: Fresh recorded orientations are interpolated with Slerp at reference timestamps for alignment and signed-axis checks. Task7 alignment uses source-bound archived physical EEF poses; separate dense command FK independently verifies ordinary signed axes for all 12 command trajectories. Task7 object-relative/contact checks use direct fresh recorded states at 20 Hz. Phase images are selected from the 30 Hz four-camera recording.
qpos_layout: Each arm has seven encoder-angle channels in radians and one gripper-width channel in metres. The common 1e-4 absolute limit also checks both gripper widths; max_qpos_delta is the maximum over all 16 channels.
review_scope: Source-command FK audit plus all sampled approach/carry/contact phase sheets in pass A, four cameras; pass B compared numerically. Not continuous video review.

task7_contact_audit_method.rule: Signed local crossbar end and complete finger-center head-region containment on every recorded held-tool sample; approach/acquire/release excluded from held-contact containment, included in posture/visual review.

tolerance_calibration.images: Retain the specified 35 dB PSNR floor: all 48 first-frame camera pairs must pass. This accommodates the measured renderer variation without relaxing the floor.
tolerance_calibration.physical: Retain the specified 1e-4 rad joint-angle, 1e-4 m block-position and 0.05 degree block-orientation limits: every observed repeat delta is reported above and must pass those limits. Gripper-width channels also use 1e-4 m.
tolerance_calibration.scope: Empirical repeatability for this pinned Isaac/GPU/driver environment and these twelve seeds; two repeats do not establish a distribution or guarantee across different GPU/driver builds.
